generation_notes: The object is modeled as a rectangular shell. The top view provides the XY footprint. The front view provides the Z height and the location/size of the window cutout. The window is treated as a through-cutout on the front face.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
